composer.json direct bump, and an override that adds the child to require (re-marshalled, as the CLI always did).
-- changes --
[
 {"name":"monolog/monolog","ecosystem":"composer","to":"1.27.1","method":"direct","file":"composer.json"},
 {"name":"guzzlehttp/psr7","ecosystem":"composer","to":"2.5.0","method":"override","file":"composer.json"}
]
-- in:composer.json --
{
  "require": {
    "monolog/monolog": "^1.0"
  }
}
-- out:composer.json --
{
    "require": {
        "guzzlehttp/psr7": "^2.5.0",
        "monolog/monolog": "^1.27.1"
    }
}
